sources.title: DeepSR: A deep learning tool for image super resolution
sources.snippet: An open source tool is introduced that provides a versatile environment to meet the needs of researchers in developing deep learning (DL) algorithms for single image super-resolution reconstruction (SISR). The processes of SISR were carefully studied, unified and integrated to create software that can be used by the community for any type of imaging method such as aerial, medical, optical, etc ...
